long.caption: That idea deserves a first chapter.
long.text: Every book starts as a thought worth saving. Book Genesis Five helps you turn that thought into a working manuscript.

long.caption: Python 3.10+ · Your chosen model route
long.text: Install with Python three point ten or newer, and connect the model route you already use.

long.caption: Start with one sentence.
long.text: Run book genesis new. Add one sentence for your idea, and choose the language.

long.caption: Review. Leave a note. Resume later.
long.text: Review the brief, outline, and first chapter. Press Enter to continue, or type a note to steer the work. Quit and resume whenever you need.

long.caption: Read locally. Compare versions.
long.text: Your drafts and revision history stay on your machine. Open the local reader, move between chapters, and compare versions.

long.caption: Markdown + EPUB · Partial work is labeled
long.text: Export your working manuscript as Markdown or E pub. Incomplete projects are labeled as partial.
